annotations.title: Describe, move or delete a media file

description:
[Admin] With action update (the default): change a file's name, alt text, focal point or poster, or move it to another folder ("" is the top). Fields left out keep their value. alt replaces the whole set of languages. A null focal_x, focal_y or poster_url clears it. A move gives the file a new `url`: live pages keep the old one and page drafts move at once (drafts_updated). With action delete and only media_id: delete the file for good; this cannot be undone. Refused while a page, brand, CSS file, style setting, company logo or branding, interview, position, blog post, avatar or coaching catalogue uses it: the error lists what does, and those uses are changed separately.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

action.description: `update` (default) changes the fields you send. `delete` deletes the file: send only media_id. It is refused with 409 while a page, brand, CSS file, style setting, company logo or branding, interview, position, blog post, avatar or coaching catalogue uses it (the answer lists what does); it cannot be undone.

alt.description: Alt text per language code. Replaces the whole set, so send every language.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

focal_x.description: Horizontal focal point, 0 (left) to 1 (right). Null clears it.

focal_y.description: Vertical focal point, 0 (top) to 1 (bottom). Null clears it.

folder.description: Move the file to this folder; "" is the top. The file gets a new address in that folder; the old address keeps working for published pages, and page drafts move to the new one.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

poster_url.description: Still image shown before a video plays: the `url` of an image in this company's library. Null removes it.

name: manage_media_file
